items.title: [Well-being] ADHD in 3D | 17 October 2026
items.author: Wong Hwee Ming
items.description:
As part of ADHD Awareness Month 2026, we warmly invite the Hwa Chong Institution community to ADHD in 3D: Step Inside My Mind, a free public awareness event this Saturday, 17 October 2026.
Through immersive experiences and real stories, visitors can better understand ADHD and appreciate how empathy and practical support make a difference. The event also features talks, activities, performances and a community marketplace.
Date: Saturday, 17 October 2026
Time: 10.00am–9.00pm
Venue: Temasek Shophouse,
28 Orchard Road, Singapore 238832
Admission: Free
More information:
https://bit.ly/adhdin3d
We would be grateful if your school could circulate the attached official ADHD in 3D event graphic and this invitation to teachers, school counsellors, parents and students through your usual communication channels. Families are welcome to visit at their convenience.
Thank you for supporting ADHD awareness and inclusion in Singapore.
Warm regards,
Daniel Ang
General Manager
Unlocking ADHD Ltd | IPC-Registered Charity
daniel@unlockingadhd.com
www.unlockingadhd.com
